text:
nina: Heads up — vendor called, short on h100 in us-east1 tonight. They can shift 8 GPUs to us-east4 for us if we sign an addendum. Can anyone confirm if staging can use us-east4 for the nightly inference sweep? (TKT-8423)
sam: If it's just staging, yes. We'll need a tiny terraform PR to add a region mapping, should be quick.
leo: FYI demo-pool currently shows 4 spare h100s in us-east4 but those are reserved for scheduled demos.
priya: What's the expected burn/cost? Need finance sign-off before we commit.
nina: Quick estimate: 8 GPUs * $3.2/hr * 5 hr ~= $128. Vendor quoted $3.2/hr per h100 on-demand. They also require VLAN peering — config snippet below:

```
# add region mapping
resource "redwood_cloud_region_map" "staging" {
  from = "us-east1"
  to   = "us-east4"
  reason = "vendor capacity shift for nightly sweep"
}
```

sam: I can open the PR and link it here once created.
leo: I'd prefer we borrow the demo-pool first before committing to vendor addendum. @nina can you check demo usage for tonight?
nina: Demo calendar shows only an internal deck at 11am PST, looks like we can borrow. I'll ping the demo owner now. Also — what's the fallback if peering setup or vendor handoff flails?
sam: Fallback plan: reduce concurrency and route requests to the smaller model variant (l4s). I'll add an A/B router policy so we can automatically fallback when region != us-east1.
priya: Finance is OK with the ~$128 if product signs off. @maria from product — ok to run the sweep in us-east4?
maria: Fine by me, go ahead.
nina: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/492 — adds region map + routing fallback. cc @sam
sam: LGTM, minimal change. I'll land once demo owner confirms.
leo: Demo owner just confirmed by DM. Landing now.
devops-bot: Deploy started for infra/pr/492 — smoke tests queued.
nina: Thanks all :thumbsup:
